jobs.title: Machine Learning Intern/Co-op (Winter 2027)
jobs.descriptionPlain:
WHO ARE WE?

FICTIONAL recorded response for automated tests. Aurora Lattice is an imaginary enterprise AI company headquartered in Toronto, with offices in Montreal and Vancouver.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers.

Why this role?

Ship state of the art models to production.

Design and implement novel research ideas.

Please Note: To be eligible for this position you should be a student currently enrolled in a post-secondary program, available for a full-time 4-month co-op.

As a Machine Learning Intern, you will:

 - Design, train and improve upon cutting-edge models.

 - Help us develop new techniques to train and serve models.

 - Collaborate with researchers on evaluation and safety.

You may be a good fit if you have:

 - Proficiency in Python and related ML frameworks such as JAX or PyTorch.

 - Experience with large-scale distributed training.

 - Strong communication and problem-solving skills.

Beware of scams: Aurora Lattice never asks for payment. Verify roles on https://aurora-lattice.example/careers before applying.
